name: SunRay Denali 4-Person Traditional Outdoor Sauna 400D5
description: Description Experience the perfect fusion of modern design and traditional wellness with the SunRay Denali 4-Person Contemporary Outdoor Sauna. Crafted from rustic Canadian red cedar and protected by a durable sloped metal roof, this sauna is built to withstand harsh climates while offering a sleek, low-maintenance exterior. With a spacious interior, ergonomic bench seating, and a powerful 6kW Harvia electric heater, the Denali provides a luxurious and restorative experience, right in your backyard. Features Sealed weatherproof red cedar cabin for year-round outdoor use Contemporary sloped metal roof enhances durability and modern appeal 6kW Harvia electric heater heats up to 170°F for a deep, relaxing sweat Ergonomic bench seating along two walls allows sitting or lying down Interior dome lighting with auto shut-off for safe illumination Includes sand timer and hygrometer for monitoring steam and session time Cask and spoon provided for traditional steam-enhancing water pours ETL/CSA Certified – safe for both U.S. and Canadian electrical standards Backed by a 7-year warranty for long-term peace of mind What's Included? Rustic red cedar sauna cabin with sealed weatherproof finish 6kW Harvia electric heater with stones Cask and spoon for water pouring Hygrometer and sand timer Interior dome lighting system Specifications Brand SunRay Model Denali 400D5 Application Outdoor Maximum Capacity 4 persons Primary Material Canadian Red Cedar Heat Source Traditional Steam Heater Type 6.0 kW Harvia Electric Heater with Stones Temperature Range Up to 170°F Power Requirements 220V, 30 amp dedicated circuit Exterior Dimensions (H x W x D) 89" x 72" x 62" Interior Dimensions (H x W x D) 75" x 68" x 58" Roof Dimensions 89" x 83" Bench Dimensions 68" (L) x 19" (D) Certification ETL/CSA Certified (U.S. & Canada) Warranty 7-Year Limited Warranty Documents D5 Series Assembly Manual
